SQL Server DBA M/V/X
Référence 5874249
|
Créé le 16 juin 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée déterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 4 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
We are seeking an experienced SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA) to join a dynamic team managing infrastructure database projects for a multinational organization.
Work Location:
This role offers a hybrid working model, with around two days per week in the Brussels office. You will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple countries.
Job Description:
As a technical expert within the infrastructure database project team, you will take ownership of planning and executing multiple projects within the SQL Server domain. Your responsibilities will include ensuring high-quality deliverables, adherence to standards, and the successful migration of existing systems to new environments. You will also facilitate a smooth handover from project teams to support groups.
Key Responsibilities:
Conducting technical evaluations of the current database environment
Designing and implementing new database environments
Migrating database components efficiently
Coordinating and communicating with end users
Collaborating with various teams (infrastructure and applications)
Profil
Experience Required:
Proven experience as a Database Administrator in an infrastructure-focused role
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in large and complex environments
5-10 years of relevant experience
Technical Skills Required:
The ideal candidate will have:
In-depth knowledge of SQL Server products, including SSAS, SSRS, SSIS, and MDS
Expertise in database internals, queries, schema design, linked servers, and agent jobs
Proficiency in Windows Server
A solid understanding of infrastructure components such as monitoring, virtualization, storage, and networking
Strong oral and written communication skills
Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
